rows.claim: An organ is live only when the loop invokes it AND leaves durable evidence; module imports, CLI presence, or docs are declarations, not liveness.
rows.quote: Liveness = the loop invokes it AND leaves durable evidence.
rows.steal: One seat one sitting: run a liveness classification over any new organ claim in the next intake; land the verdict row in the intake card.
rows.falsifier: An organ whose imports succeed and whose call site exists but which never produces a durable artifact while the loop runs green would falsify the law as enforced.

rows.claim: A board post can influence execution but cannot authorize execution by itself; a roast may become a proposal, never a permission; consensus raises confidence, never authorizes a side effect.
rows.quote: A roast can become a proposal. It cannot become a permission. Consensus raises confidence; it cannot authorize a side effect.
rows.steal: Fold into the seat-contract v1 template as the authority clause on the next mesh seat onboarding (mesh foundations already hold the seat_contract.v1 slot).
rows.falsifier: A case where a board/social post directly triggers a side effect with no grant record would falsify the claimed separation.

rows.claim: The board may generate attention; the switchboard may grant authority; only the effect broker may cause side effects; the receipt layer records what actually happened.
rows.quote: The board may generate attention. The switchboard may grant authority. Only the effect broker may cause side effects. The receipt layer records what actually happened.
rows.steal: Name the four layers verbatim in the K8S_RACTOR 12-organ map entry for the effect broker so the 10-02 mesh verdict (k8s=executor-never-brain) cites its own 08-30 ancestor.
rows.falsifier: An architecture where the board itself grants authority or the switchboard itself writes side effects without a broker layer would break the four-layer invariant.

rows.falsifier: A completion claim accepted on exit-code-only evidence with no postcondition check, later shown false, would confirm rather than falsify; the law is falsified if exit codes are proven sufficient in adversarial audit.
